fuel_consumption.source_quote: A one dollar change per barrel crude oil = $5.6M impact on fuel expense; one cent per gallon = $2.3M. Frontier hedged: 5% of Q2, Q3, Q4 2011 at Dec 31, 2010; by subsequent date: 15% Q2, 10% Q3, 10% Q4.

instrument_type_details.notes: Republic's Frontier operation hedged 5% of anticipated volume in Q2, Q3, Q4 2011 at Dec 31, 2010. Subsequent: Frontier hedged 15% Q2, 10% Q3, 10% Q4. Instruments include call options, fuel swap agreements, and costless collars on various oil derivative commodities. Fair value of fuel hedging derivatives = $2.7M (asset) at Dec 31, 2010 (from item8 notes). Fixed-fee CPA operations unhedged. Republic announced intent to discontinue Midwest Airlines trade name in 2010.

warnings: Only Frontier branded operations hedged; fixed-fee CPA operations fuel pass-through.
